_doc: 風向（Wind）keyword-heat container + last30days dispatcher. Exploration layer — output NEVER enters investment_protocol decisions (buy_threshold / position_size / verdict) and NEVER writes Dashboard/market_mood.json atmosphere indicators or nexus/claim_ledger.jsonl. Lead-lag criteria are pre-registered in docs/wind_evaluation_criteria.md and must not be tuned after seeing data.

budget._doc: Hard USD ceiling for social scans. Unlike the X KOL collector (billed per resource returned), a last30days scan bills per SCAN across several data providers, so cost IS knowable before the call — check() therefore pre-authorizes one scan at price_per_scan_usd. Cumulative, never auto-resets; raise total_usd deliberately or run `budget.py --reset`. price_per_scan_usd covers paid retrieval sources only; planner/rerank/fun judge use broker-selected logged-in CLI subscriptions and consume broker quota, not an external reasoning API key. Recalibrate retrieval cost after the first 10 real scans against provider dashboards.

heat._doc: Decay weights, hand-calibrated like the rest of the exploration layer — no agent may auto-tune them. half_life_days is deliberately SHORTER than x_kol.json's 3.0: a break-news keyword's relevance decays faster than a KOL's thematic conviction. kind_weight lets a resolved ticker outrank a vague theme at equal mention count. materiality_scale maps bn triage.materiality_score (observed range ~2.5-2.75 on straight news) onto a multiplier.
heat._ranking_doc: RAW SCORE IS NOT THE RANKING KEY. Measured 2026-08-16 on 14 days of real bn_*.json, ranking by raw score returns NVDA / AI capex / SPY / AMZN / MSFT / QQQ — i.e. it measures coverage VOLUME, and the permanently-covered mega-caps win every tick forever. 風向 is about CHANGE, so terms are ranked by `surprise` = (recent mention rate) / (baseline mention rate), computed as the ratio of a fast-decayed score to a slow-decayed one, both normalized to a per-day rate. A constantly-covered name scores ~1.0; a term that just accelerated scores well above it. surface_min_score still gates on the RAW score, so a single mention of an obscure term cannot win on ratio alone.
heat._min_mentions_doc: Corroboration gate. `mentions` is counted AFTER url_hash dedupe, so it is the number of DISTINCT articles/posts carrying the term. Without this, ranking by surprise inverts the raw-score problem: a single listicle naming IYR / JEPI / QYLD / XYLD once each hands all four a top slot, because one mention against a near-zero baseline is maximal acceleration. Three independent carriers is the same bar the Nexus layer already applies before promoting a claim.
heat._stop_terms_doc: Broad-market proxies are never the SUBJECT of a story — they are the backdrop every macro article names. Excluded from the queue only; they still accumulate and remain visible in the table. Sector ETFs are deliberately NOT here: XLE can genuinely be what a story is about.

dispatch._doc: One scan per tick at most. A quiet hour costs $0 — the same 'no work, no spend' property the X KOL collector already proved. cooldown_hours starts when a scan completes; rescan_score_jump is the fraction by which a term's score must exceed its score_at_scan to break cooldown early (0.5 = +50%). max_scans_per_day is a second ceiling independent of the USD cap. reasoning_agents is an allowlist; the quota broker selects the currently available logged-in CLI for the whole scan. Broker unavailable/refused and malformed CLI JSON fail closed instead of degrading to local-score.

_excluded_sources_note: tiktok and instagram are deliberately absent from dispatch.sources. Verified 2026-08-16 in the engine source: lib/tiktok.py:430 _profile_videos and lib/instagram.py:478 _user_reels fetch a creator's ENTIRE recent timeline and append it with only a video-id dedupe — there is no topic post-filter on either lane. In the AAOI sample run they contributed 7 of 9 Instagram items and 5 of 18 TikTok items that were wholly unrelated to the topic.
